definitions.gloss: robust; strong and healthy; hardy; sturdy
definitions.explanation: Having a strong, healthy body that is resistant to illness and fatigue. Emphasizes physical vitality and toughness.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{強健|きょうけん}な{体|からだ}の{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}だ。
examples.english: My grandfather has a robust body.

examples.japanese: {強健|きょうけん}な{体|からだ}を{維持|いじ}するために{毎日|まいにち}{運動|うんどう}している。
examples.english: I exercise every day to maintain a strong, healthy body.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{強健|きょうけん}な{体格|たいかく}で、{風邪|かぜ}ひとつ{引|ひ}いたことがない。
examples.english: He has a sturdy build and has never even caught a cold.

notes:
Compound of {強|きょう} (strong) + {健|けん} (healthy). A somewhat literary or formal way to describe physical robustness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {強健|きょうけん}な{体|からだ}: a robust body
- {強健|きょうけん}な{体格|たいかく}: a sturdy physique
- {心身|しんしん}ともに{強健|きょうけん}: strong in both mind and body

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
Do not confuse with {強権|きょうけん} (authoritarian power), which has the same pronunciation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {頑丈|がんじょう}: sturdy, solidly built — used for both people and objects
- {健康|けんこう}: healthy — more common in everyday speech
- {丈夫|じょうぶ}: strong, durable — more colloquial
